remarks: Seller requests highest and best offers, with complete terms, by Tuesday 12PM. Turn-key and ideally set on a cul-de-sac near the Greenwich and Westover border, 192 Barclay Drive offers updated living, flexible space, and convenience less than one hour from NYC. Beautifully maintained, the home features sun-filled rooms, refinished hardwood floors, a recently renovated kitchen, updated baths, premium custom windows, new siding, upgraded HVAC, and numerous recent system improvements that reflect exceptional care. The private backyard is designed for both relaxation and entertaining, with a pool, refreshed deck, updated hardscape, and inviting outdoor spaces. An integrated wing of the home adds exceptional versatility, ideal for an in-law suite, guest quarters, pool lounge, home office, or studio.  Just minutes to the Merritt Parkway, shopping, and dining.
